formDescription: Personal-information branch step. Lets the applicant select who the requested records are about: themselves, a child under 12, and/or another person. At least one option must be selected; the combination selected determines the routing to subsequent steps (e.g. child-information, another-information, adoption).

about_yourself.title: Yourself
about_yourself.description: Select if you are requesting records about yourself.

about_child.title: A child under 12 years old
about_child.description: Select if you are requesting records about a child under 12 years old, including your own child.

about_another.title: Another person
about_another.description: Select if you are requesting records on behalf of another person.

notes: No individual checkbox is marked required by the Angular validators, but at least one of the three must be checked to enable Continue (enforced in component logic, not the FormGroup).
